integrity: The theorem is proved analytically. The bundled finite checks are regression checks only and are not used as a substitute for proof. The two-player center phenomenon is acknowledged as classical background; the claimed contribution is the source-specific volume and parity classification.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the robust no-dominance directed-cycle class under continuous-time multi-population replicator dynamics. Global periodicity is proved only for the two-player odd-inverter-parity case; higher-dimensional global limit sets are not classified.
title: Logit-volume preservation and the sharp mixed-equilibrium stability boundary
